format:
  html:
    toc: true

---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
source("assets/lib_io.R")
source("assets/lib_blast.R")
source("assets/lib_plasmid_lineage.R")

fa <- read_fasta("report_data/plasmids.fasta")
n_plasmids <- length(fa)
fig_h <- function(min = 4, per_seq = 0.5) max(min, per_seq * n_plasmids)

seqlen <- tibble(seq = names(fa), seqlen = width(fa))
```

```{r annotations}
# Positions of the AMR and plasmid typing annotations of the plasmids
pos_pat <- "([0-9]+)(-|\\.\\.)([0-9]+)(:([-+]))?"
read_annotations <- function(f) {
	read_tsv(f, col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>    # the plasmids of the set only
		mutate(
			seq = contig_id,
			start = str_extract(position, pos_pat, 1) |> as.integer(),
			end = str_extract(position, pos_pat, 3) |> as.integer(),
			strand = str_extract(position, pos_pat, 5)
		)
}
res_gff <- read_annotations("report_data/multitable_resistances.tsv")
inc_gff <- read_annotations("report_data/multitable_plasmidfinder_hits.tsv")

plasmid_types <- tibble(contig_id = names(fa)) |>
	left_join(
		inc_gff |>
			group_by(contig_id) |>
			summarise(plasmid_types = str_c(sort(unique(plasmid_type)), collapse = ",")),
		by = "contig_id"
	) |>
	mutate(plasmid_types = replace_na(plasmid_types, "none"))
```

# Plasmids

`r n_plasmids` plasmids.

```{r}
seqlen |>
	left_join(plasmid_types, by = c(seq = "contig_id")) |>
	left_join(
		res_gff |>
			group_by(seq) |>
			summarise(resistances = str_c(sort(unique(resistance_name)), collapse = ", ")),
		by = "seq"
	) |>
	knitr::kable(col.names = c("Plasmid", "Length (bp)", "Plasmid types", "Resistances"))
```

# ANI of the plasmids

Mean identity of the BLASTN alignments (≥500 bp) of each pair of plasmids. The plasmids are ordered by
single linkage clustering of their ANI in the rest of the report.

```{r}
#| fig-height: !expr fig_h(6)
#| fig-width: !expr fig_h(6)
aln <- read_blast6("report_data/plasmids.self.blastn")
ani <- blast_ani(aln)
ani_h <- ani_hclust(ani)
ani_levels <- ani_h$labels[ani_h$order]

ani |>
	mutate(across(c(query_id, subject_id), ~ factor(., ani_levels))) |>
	ggplot(aes(x = query_id, y = subject_id, fill = ani)) +
		geom_tile() +
		coord_equal() +
		scale_fill_continuous(limits = c(98, 100), oob = scales::squish) +
		theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
		xlab("") + ylab("")
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
plot(ani_h, xlab = "", sub = "", main = "Single linkage clustering on 100 - ANI")
```

# Alignments

```{r}
#| fig-height: !expr fig_h(8, 1.2)
#| fig-width: !expr fig_h(8, 1.2)
aln <- aln |>
	mutate(across(c(query_id, subject_id), ~ factor(., ani_levels)))
gg_pw_alignment(aln)
```

Alignments (≥1 kb) of consecutive plasmids. The labels give the number of mismatches and of gap openings
of each alignment. Resistance genes are drawn in red, plasmid replicons in yellow.

```{r}
#| fig-height: !expr fig_h(6, 0.6)
#| fig-width: 15
polygons <- alignment_polygons(aln, ani_levels)
seqlen_f <- mutate(seqlen, seq = factor(seq, ani_levels))
gg_alignment_polygons(polygons, seqlen_f) +
	geom_segment(aes(x = start, xend = end, y = seq, yend = seq), data = mutate(inc_gff, seq = factor(seq, ani_levels)), linewidth = 2, color = "yellow") +
	geom_segment(aes(x = start, xend = end, y = seq, yend = seq), data = mutate(res_gff, seq = factor(seq, ani_levels)), linewidth = 2, color = "red") +
	theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```
